scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T api pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.db:generate: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml exec api pnpm run db:generate
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T api pnpm run db:reset && bash scripts/seed-database.sh

auditConfig.//: Two classes of advisory. (1) NO override needed — brace-expansion / fast-uri / js-yaml / nanoid / form-data / qs / vite / rollup: every parent already declares a semver range that admits the patched release, so a lockfile refresh resolves them naturally; carrying an override only papers over a stale lockfile. (rollup's only vulnerable source was @sentry/nextjs@8; the v10 upgrade dropped rollup from the Sentry chain, so its override is gone.) (2) Overrides below ARE load-bearing — the parent pins/caps the transitive BELOW its patch, so a refresh can't reach it: @fastify/swagger-ui pins @fastify/static, drizzle-kit's @esbuild-kit pins esbuild, next pins postcss (~8.4.x) and sharp, node-cron pins uuid@8. The real fix for each is upgrading the owning dep. ignoreGhsas is empty — nothing suppressed. (@sentry/nextjs v10 also moved OpenTelemetry to 2.x, clearing the previously-deferred @opentelemetry/core GHSA-8988 medium.)
